card.summary: EUR 10 in free credits on signup, with an OpenAI-compatible EU-hosted API. Qwen 3.8 27B is priced at USD 0.35 per million input tokens after the credit.

record.chaining: the one-off EUR 10 signup credit binds before the per-token prices

limits.value: EUR 10 free credits on signup; Qwen 3.8 27B at USD 0.35 per million input tokens afterwards

identity_cost.detail: create an account at app.koscompute.com/sign-up to receive the EUR 10 credit; the page states self-service with no waiting

evidence.quote: Get €10 in free credits when you sign up to try our API for free.

record.notes: the only free allowance is a one-off EUR 10 signup credit, after which usage is per-token paid
